title: Hot CPI Data Spikes Yields: Tech Falls, ABBV Record Highs
speaker: Drew Dosek

macro_themes.view: Hotter inflation combined with higher yields and heavy capex is dampening investor buying enthusiasm.
Soaring CoreWeave debt yields show AI data-center build-out is getting costlier to finance and profitability is receding.
Tanker attacks in Hormuz keep escalating; after the midterms almost anything can happen, which could push oil higher.

calls.condition: If selling continues tomorrow, watch for traction at 7,657 down to the 7,640 gap fill
calls.reason: Down ~1.1% on hot CPI; failed to separate from the neckline so the inverse head and shoulders is negated; trendline/gap-fill support below.
calls.quote: with today's price action, goodbye inverse head and shoulders pattern for me at least today

calls.instrument_quoted: Nasdaq Composite (IXIC); QQQ neckline also cited
calls.condition: Close back above 26,900 and the selling is likely behind us near term; below 26,614 likely more selling. QQQ must hold its 722.93 neckline
calls.reason: IXIC closed below the March uptrend line for the first time but stays above the broken declining trendline; QQQ inverse H&S still intact above 722.93.
calls.quote: If we get underneath 26,614 points, that likely will lead to more selling pressure.

calls.reason: Seven days down into the 50% line of a long-term parallel channel plus the 0.786 fib, so due for a technical bounce toward the channel top.
calls.quote: We are due for a technical bounce, some little reprieve to allow the price action to meander back up

calls.reason: Yield spiked on CPI then faded to close lower; weekly and daily 'sleeper hold' patterns have capped it and curled it over.
calls.quote: We should be seeing further downside. That was a weekly sleeper hold

calls.condition: Daily closes below 4,104 open 3,900 then 3,800; at 3,500 he is a buyer of physical gold
calls.reason: Holding support at 4,104 despite elevated yields; a flush to 3,800-3,900 would be a buying opportunity and the 2025 consolidation shelf at 3,500 is his physical buy level.
calls.quote: If we get price action on gold to come down to that level, I'm a buyer of physical gold.

calls.condition: Starts buying physical silver at 53.26; keeps dry powder to buy more if it reaches ~35
calls.reason: Closed below the 50% line of its parallel channel, bringing the head-and-shoulders target of 53.26 into view; channel bottom much lower.
calls.quote: brings the head and shoulders target of $53.26... Near term though, first buy area for me, 53 bucks and 26 cents.

calls.condition: Repeated tests of ~80.5k support make a break more likely
calls.reason: Chopping sideways but bear-flagging right on top of support dating to Nov 2025; major resistance at the inclining trend line.
calls.quote: The bad news, it's bear flagging right on top of that pair uh right on top of that trend line of support.

calls.condition: As long as price stays above the declining trendline (H&S neckline), measured move targets 116, likely meaning Middle East escalation
calls.reason: Seven up days into a narrow-body bar suggests sideways chop first; head-and-shoulders measured move to 116; tankers being hit and escalation risk after midterms.
calls.quote: that is the neckline of a head and shoulders pattern with a targeted measured move up here at $116.

calls.condition: Would buy on a pullback to the 3.22-3.32 area
calls.reason: Daily RSI hit 70 twice and no retrace after the breakout, so expects a pullback before buying.
calls.quote: We've had a great run on nat gas... we should be due for a little bit more of a pullback.

calls.condition: Any bounce likely rejected at 79.13; continued selling targets the 60.82 gap fill then ~59.72
calls.reason: Senior unsecured debt yields spiked to ~14.8-14.9%, making AI capex financing costlier; oversold (RSI ~29) but narrative is bad.
calls.quote: the narrative surrounding this is pretty bad. So, I anticipate more selling pressure to bleed into tomorrow.

calls.condition: Should bounce from 182.78 trendline to ~195; a break of it could take price to ~136, where he is a buyer
calls.reason: Steep decline into inclining trendline support after filling a gap; bottom of the inclining parallel channel at ~136 is a major support confluence.
calls.quote: If that price comes down here to the bottom of that parallel, I would be a nice buyer on NBIS

calls.condition: Holding the 506.62 support confluence could yield a swing back to ~539; continued consolidation there risks a drop to 488.21
calls.reason: Three supports (channel 50%, rising trendline, gap fill) converge, but the bounce was only ~1%, showing weak AI sentiment.
calls.quote: Could even be a a swing trade to push us back up and retest the 539 range.

calls.condition: If rejected and it consolidates sideways, a further push likely meets stout resistance at ~295
calls.reason: Up 3.3% to record highs on a red day; stalling at the 50% line of its parallel channel; next resistance where channel and trendline meet.
calls.quote: Boom, right into both the 50% area of the parallel and that inclining trend line at 295.

notes: No date stated; it is the CPI-release day (CPI 'today', PPI tomorrow), which other videos place on Wed 2026-10-14, so listing date 10-15 is probably a day late. S&P levels transcribed as '76571' and '76397', read as 7,657.1 and 7,639.7. Nasdaq call uses IXIC units; QQQ neckline 722.93 noted in condition. Nat gas ticker NG is outside the canonical list.
